description: Dated external events (clinical-trial readouts, approvals, filings, publications) for the temporal / event-study track. Each event carries the bitemporal stamps TEMPORAL.md requires, every date externally attested. This store is DISTINCT from the finance adversarial corpus (records/): it feeds the event-study driver (agentic-qr event_study.py), which aligns knowable_time to forward price windows under the no-lookahead discipline.

fields.source: {registry, id, url, verified} -- the attesting external source
fields.ticker: public-company ticker whose price the event may move (nullable)
fields.event_time: ISO date the underlying result held / registry milestone (with event_time_source)
fields.knowable_time: ISO date the event became MARKET-actionable (disclosure); the load-bearing stamp for as-of / no-lookahead. May PRECEDE event_time when an interim topline is disclosed before registry completion. (with knowable_time_source)
fields.outcome: {trial_result, note} -- the trial's own result, NOT a market claim
fields.evidence_basis: public_reference when dates are externally attested

discipline: The event study uses knowable_time, mapped to the next tradeable bar (a pre-market release like 05:45 EDT is actionable at that day's open). event_time and knowable_time are recorded separately and may differ; conflating them is the classic lookahead bug. No price data or market claim is asserted here -- only the externally-attested event and its timing.
